title: potentilla alpestris subsp. baldensis
intro: Potentilla alpestris subsp. baldensis, commonly known as Alpine Cinquefoil, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family, Rosaceae. Alpine Cinquefoil is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and fighting off infections, making it a valuable remedy for various health issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Cinquefoil include tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
